title: Drummers Happy and Faso, and Chris Kelly and Sam Morgan bands
summary: He praises Happy and Faso, then recalls playing with Chris Kelly's band and compares it with Sam Morgan's.

bands.name: Chris Kelly's New Orleans Jazz Band

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
